Persisting it with two named data files writes three copies and three records, and both data records name the figure. A project with no persist root configured is refused, with the setting's name in the message and nothing written. A repeat persist of an unchanged source writes no second record. A copy whose bytes are altered before the check is refused, and leaves no record. The test asserts that the real crew home and docs state are untouched afterwards. Negative control: skipping the hash check makes the altered-copy case pass a corrupt copy and fail the test. Ruff adds no findings on the staged paths. Write paths: one new module under reckon/crew/ , the flight schema, and the new test.
